item.title: Dolly Parton’s Older Brother Coy ‘Denver’ Parton Dies at 82
item.description:
Here's a short podcast script based on the article:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to this week's music news update. We're starting with some sad news from the world of country music. Dolly Parton's older brother, Coy 'Denver' Parton, has passed away at the age of 82.
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: "According to an obituary shared by the Atchley Funeral Home in Sevierville, Tennessee, Denver Parton died on July 23rd. While he lived a private life, we do know that he worked as a crane operator, building bridges, and was also a homestead farmer and avid hunter.
Host: "Denver was one of 12 children born to Lee and Avie Lee Owens Parton in Sevier County, Tennessee. His sister Dolly has often spoken about their large family and rural upbringing, which has inspired much of her music and public identity.
Host: "Denver is survived by his daughters, grandchildren, and several siblings, including Dolly. This marks another loss for the Parton family in recent years, following the passing of Dolly's brothers Randy, Floyd, and David.
[Soft music continues to play]
Host: "Dolly Parton has not publicly commented on her brother's passing, but we know that she and her family are people of faith. As she said after her brother Randy's passing, 'We are a family of faith and we believe that he is safe with God.'
Host: "On a separate note, Dolly Parton remains one of the most influential artists in country music history, with 25 number one songs on the Billboard Hot Country Songs chart. She was inducted into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame in 2022 and recently announced a Broadway-bound musical based on her life and career.
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for now. Our condolences go out to the Parton family during this difficult time. Thanks for tuning in to this week's music news update."
